rule: Do not relax a published field until this table says INTERNAL_ONLY or DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. PRODUCT_CONSUMED fields are judged by fixture truth and product-gate decisions, not by spread bit-identity.

bpm.host_rule: Settled stationary lock must equal the fixture BPM (1 BPM bin). Earlier correct lock is allowed. Wrong-octave episodes must be no worse than spread.

phase01.host_rule: Once settled, beat-event timing error vs analytical click <= 7500 us. Do not judge solely vs spread.

consumers: waveform_tempo / river / comet: smoothstep(0.30, 0.60, confidence) velocity/presence gate
beat_aware_director: tempo_locked AND tempo_confidence >= 0.45 (director default floor)
k1_audio_profile.h: lock floor is microphone-specific; 0.60 is current K1_LOCK_CONFIDENCE
not_consumers: k1_smart_director.confidence_floor is novelty/energy mode_intent, NOT tempo confidence
confidence.host_rule: No numeric epsilon. Discretise to product bands: <0.30 idle, >=0.45 director-trust, >=0.60 lock/full-gate. Silence must not enter the lock band. Continuous values retained for later eyes-on.

locked.host_rule: Silence false locks = 0. Settled click trains must lock. Acquisition may be earlier than spread. Wrong lock no worse than spread.

consumers: stale-republish clearer on non-emit AP frames (one-shot contract)
beat_tick.host_rule: Silence ticks = 0. Settled extra/missing beats vs analytical fixture = 0. Timing error <= 7500 us.

consumers: pulse_prism: hard threshold 0.55 plus continuous beat_mod
beat_strength.host_rule: Hard gate beat_strength > 0.55 must not fire incorrectly (silence / unlocked). Continuous magnitude is eyes-on later; no invented epsilon.

acf_valid.internal_use: Gates ACF salience vs Goertzel-confidence fallback inside k1_tempo.cpp
acf_valid.external_consumers: serial tempo_stream / APCAD flags only (#if ENABLE_TEMPO_STREAM)
acf_valid.host_rule: MAY_DIFFER. Earlier true is expected for rolling ACF.

winner_bin.note: Published product field is bpm (winner centre), not the bin index. Bin index is debug.
winner_bin.host_rule: MAY_DIFFER if bpm remains the correct fixture BPM.

v2_locked.host_rule: MAY_DIFFER if product locked matches truth.

raw_ACF_cells.host_rule: MAY_DIFFER. 6e-5–2e-4 abs err does not kill the candidate.
